result.topic_en: Euler solves for the small correction ω in the second mode of a vibrating elastic lamina, tabulates the first five values of Φ with the corresponding vibration periods and tones, and begins explaining the constant b needed to compute actual times.

items.english: But above all, to know perfectly these times of vibration and the sounds produced by them, besides the length of the vibrating lamina AB = a, one must know the value of the letter b.
